name: Custom Logo & Branding Cover
summary: Add your brand logo, colors, and custom design.
imageAlt: Branded cover on a portable wheeled evaporative air cooler
description: Fully branded cooler covers with your company logo, custom colors, and design elements. Perfect for HVAC contractors, property managers, and businesses wanting professional branded equipment protection. Available on any cover type.

name: Heavy-Duty Industrial Cover
summary: Maximum durability for large wheeled commercial air coolers.
imageAlt: Heavy-duty cover on a large portable wheeled industrial air cooler
description: Engineered with 900D industrial canvas and TPU lamination for oversized portable evaporative air coolers on heavy casters — the mobile units used in factories, logistics yards, and industrial sites. Double-stitched seams and heavy-duty buckle straps stand up to frequent moves and harsh environments.

name: Mesh Breathable Cover
summary: Breathable mesh for debris & pest protection with airflow.
imageAlt: Mesh cover on a portable wheeled evaporative air cooler
description: Lightweight mesh cover that filters out debris, leaves, and pests while maintaining full airflow. Perfect for in-season use in mild climates, or as a secondary protective layer during operational periods.

name: Round Cylinder Cover
summary: Precision-cut for round portable & cylindrical air coolers.
imageAlt: Round cover on a cylindrical portable wheeled evaporative air cooler
description: Custom-shaped cover for round and cylindrical portable evaporative coolers — including wheeled drum-style mobile units. Precision-cut circular pattern with elastic hem ensures a snug fit. Available in multiple standard diameters or fully custom dimensions.

name: Small Batch & Prototype Cover
summary: Low MOQ orders and prototyping for unique requirements.
imageAlt: Prototype cover being fitted on a portable wheeled air cooler
description: Flexible small-batch production with no minimum order requirements. Get prototypes before committing to large orders. Ideal for testing new designs, one-off custom projects, or specialty applications.

name: Standard Down Draft Cover
summary: Cover for large portable top-discharge air coolers on wheels.
imageAlt: Down-draft cover on a large portable wheeled evaporative air cooler — top discharge
description: Purpose-built for mid-to-large portable evaporative coolers with top-down (down-draft) airflow — wheeled floor-standing units used in warehouses, events, and commercial yards. Reinforced top panels, drainage channels, and UV-resistant coating handle outdoor storage and transport.

name: Standard Side Draft Cover
summary: Reliable protection for portable side-discharge air coolers on wheels.
imageAlt: Side-draft cover on a portable wheeled evaporative air cooler — front view
description: Our standard side-draft cover is designed for mid-to-large portable evaporative air coolers — the wheeled, floor-standing cabinet style common in residential and light commercial use. Made from durable 600D polyester with PU coating, it provides year-round protection from dust, rain, and UV damage. Hem clearance fits caster wheels; ventilation openings prevent condensation.

name: UV Shield Cover
summary: Advanced UV-blocking technology for sun-exposed coolers.
imageAlt: UV shield cover on a portable wheeled air cooler in direct sunlight
description: Featuring our proprietary UV-blocking coating, this cover prevents sun damage, color fading, and material degradation. Ideal for coolers exposed to direct sunlight year-round. Heat-reflective outer layer keeps your cooler significantly cooler.

name: Waterproof Premium Cover
summary: 100% waterproof with sealed seams for heavy rain regions.
imageAlt: Waterproof cover on a portable wheeled evaporative air cooler outdoors
description: Our premium waterproof cover uses fully sealed seams and a multi-layer water-repellent coating to provide complete rain protection. Anti-mildew treatment and drainage grommets ensure your cooler stays dry and clean year-round.

name: Window Unit Cover
summary: Custom-fit for window-mounted coolers without removal.
imageAlt: Window unit evaporative cooler cover fitted in residential window frame
description: Designed specifically for window-mounted evaporative coolers. Install the cover without removing your unit. Insulating properties help reduce drafts during the off-season. Compact design folds for easy storage.

name: Winter Insulated Cover
summary: Thermally insulated for freeze protection in cold climates.
imageAlt: Insulated cover on a portable wheeled evaporative air cooler in winter
description: Multi-layer insulated cover with thermal lining designed to protect evaporative coolers during harsh winters. Prevents freezing, ice damage, and debris accumulation. Snow-shedding exterior and tight-seal closures keep moisture out.

name: XL Commercial Cover
summary: Oversized cover for extra-large wheeled commercial coolers.
imageAlt: XL cover on an oversized portable wheeled commercial air cooler
description: Extra-large cover for the biggest portable evaporative air coolers on casters — mobile units used at hotels, restaurants, warehouses, and outdoor events. Reinforced stress points and heavy-duty fasteners handle wide cabinet spans and frequent repositioning.
